sounds.config.iceStress.option.descripti: A sound effect that is played when you jump on ice. Originally from the Icebreak mod for WinterJam 2024.
sounds.config.option.description.enableV: Should Sounds log verbose information about the block sound types in the console? This is useful for debugging purposes.
sounds.config.option.description.hideSou: Should Sounds hide the 'Sounds' button, that opens the config screen, from the vanilla sound mixer screen?
sounds.config.option.description.ignored: A list of blocks that will not have any custom sound definition settings applied to them, even if they are in a tag that has sound settings applied to it.
sounds.config.option.hideSoundsButtonInS: Hide Button In Sound Mixer Menu
sounds.config.swordSwoosh.option.descrip: A sound effect that is played when you attack with a sword.
